GIVEN a Canvas locator disguised via .describe() WHEN expectDomOverlayScreenshot is called THEN it is still rejected (guard resolves the actual DOM element, not selector text)

GIVEN a DOM overlay positioned over the Canvas WHEN captured with the same canvas mask expectDomOverlayScreenshot() applies THEN the masked capture differs from an unmasked capture (Canvas pixels are excluded)
GIVEN a compound selector locator for the Canvas WHEN expectDomOverlayScreenshot is called THEN it is rejected (compound selectors cannot bypass the guard)

GIVEN a fixture payload shaped for a pending scenario relabeled with an active scenario name WHEN the app boots THEN it is rejected before any capture is possible (relabeling cannot fabricate an active binding)
GIVEN a fixture payload with an unknown viewportLabel WHEN the app boots THEN it is rejected (fails closed rather than silently using a default viewport)
GIVEN a non-interactive overlay coordinate WHEN a real pointerdown is held THEN it passes through to the Canvas and projectiles/shots increase (AC5)
GIVEN a running-hud visual scenario fixture WHEN several RAF frames and wall-clock time elapse THEN loopPhase/sortie.status/elapsedTicks stay frozen
GIVEN an unknown registryId WHEN expectCanvasVisualCueScreenshot is called on the actual Canvas THEN it is rejected
GIVEN app loaded WHEN sortie bootstrap runs THEN sortie.status is running
GIVEN auto-paused WHEN visibilitychange visible fired THEN aria-pressed stays "true" (no auto-resume)
GIVEN auto-paused via visibilitychange (no invoker) WHEN resumed via the HUD button THEN Canvas or the resuming control ends up focused, never a stale element (AC6)
GIVEN body has focus WHEN P pressed THEN aria-pressed stays "false" (P ignored)
GIVEN canvas focused WHEN P pressed THEN aria-pressed becomes "true" (pause)
GIVEN canvas pointer held WHEN ticks elapse THEN projectile appears
GIVEN combat HUD Assist / Pause buttons WHEN clicked THEN no Canvas pointerdown combat action occurs (AC5)
GIVEN enemies field in snapshot WHEN E2E hook called THEN enemies and sortie fields present
GIVEN enemy exists WHEN projectile hits THEN enemy hp decreases or enemy defeated
GIVEN enemy near player WHEN contact damage applies THEN player.hp decreases
GIVEN enemy spawned WHEN ticks elapse THEN enemy approaches player (distance decreases)
GIVEN max HP enemy spawned WHEN rendered THEN HP label bounding box is within arena bounds
GIVEN no visual fixture WHEN the first app render completes THEN no receipt exists (AC2)
GIVEN no visual scenario installed on the page WHEN expectDomOverlayScreenshot is called THEN it rejects (scenario omitted cannot be captured)
GIVEN paused WHEN Escape pressed THEN aria-pressed becomes "false" (resume)

GIVEN paused WHEN Resume is clicked THEN aria-pressed becomes "false" (resume) (Issue #1376: the HUD Pause button itself becomes pointer-unreachable while paused, since combat HUD is inert behind the modal pause dialog -- AC4 -- so resume goes through the pause dialog's own Resume button instead of a second click on the same HUD button)

GIVEN paused via P key WHEN P is pressed again THEN it does NOT resume, because the Canvas is inert while paused (AC4) and therefore cannot hold focus, so the AC3/AC15 canvas-focus guard blocks the second P press -- resume happens via Escape or the pause dialog's Resume button instead
GIVEN running phase WHEN Escape pressed THEN aria-pressed becomes "true" (pause)
GIVEN running phase WHEN Pause button clicked THEN aria-pressed becomes "true"
GIVEN running phase WHEN visibilitychange hidden fired THEN aria-pressed becomes "true" (auto-pause)
GIVEN runtime storage key override WHEN result is confirmed THEN production key sentinel is unchanged and e2e key receives snapshot

GIVEN short sortie fixture at review viewport WHEN timeout result THEN overlay layout remains single-column

GIVEN sortie running WHEN enemies spawn THEN enemies array is non-empty
GIVEN sortie running WHEN enemy spawns and ticks elapse THEN Canvas has enemy red pixels (enemies drawn)
GIVEN sortie running WHEN running HUD baseline then combat HUD panel screenshot matches (Issue #1375: registry running-hud row target moved from sortie-status to data-combat-hud)
GIVEN sortie running WHEN sortie state machine checked THEN victory and defeat statuses are valid enum values
GIVEN the <body> element WHEN expectDomOverlayScreenshot OR expectCanvasVisualCueScreenshot is called THEN both are rejected (no Canvas exception ever applies to a full-shell target)
GIVEN the final-no-command-rail pending-fixture scenario WHEN installVisualScenario is called THEN it fails closed instead of silently freezing the current pre-overlay UI (AC4)
GIVEN the final-no-command-rail scenario is pending-baseline (registry id: final-no-command-rail) WHEN this primary VRT suite runs THEN it is skipped explicitly (AC4)

GIVEN the result-timeout active-fixture-only scenario WHEN the DOM overlay root is captured THEN it matches the legacy-current result screen baseline (AC12)
GIVEN the running-hud active-fixture-only scenario WHEN the DOM overlay root is captured THEN it matches the provisional/legacy-current baseline (AC5, AC6)
GIVEN the running-hud fixture (elapsedTicks: 900, fixedDeltaMs: 16) WHEN the combat HUD renders THEN combat-hud-elapsed reads 14.4 s, matching CombatHudViewModel.elapsedLabel (AC4, AC8)
GIVEN the running-hud fixture WHEN the app finishes its first render THEN the receipt AND the combat HUD Hull value both reflect the fixture (AC4)
GIVEN the running-hud-paused active-fixture-only scenario WHEN the DOM overlay root is captured THEN it matches the legacy-current pause dialog baseline (AC12)
